newsitem.title: USA: Southern Pacific names Makowiecki as CFO.
newsitem.headline: Southern Pacific names Makowiecki as CFO.

text.p: Southern Pacific Funding Corp said in a statement it appointed Peter Makowiecki as executive vice president, chief financial officer and secretary effective June 23.
Makowiecki fills the position held on an interim basis by Bernard Guy, executive vice president.
Before joining Southern Pacific Funding, Makowiecki was executive vice president and CFO of Fleet Mortgage Group.

Southern Pacific based in Lake Oswego, Oregon, is a finance company engaged in the business of originating, purchasing and selling home equity loans made to borrowers whose borrowing needs may not be met by traditional financial institutions.
